# TanBase Core

Open-source TanStack Start application foundation for Cloudflare Workers.

Canonical context:
- README.md: public overview and quick start
- AGENTS.md: AI operating contract and source hierarchy
- docs/OVERVIEW.md: product and architecture source of truth
- docs/FEATURES.md: roadmap and acceptance criteria
- docs/STATUS.md: dated local, preview, and production status
- docs/DEVELOPMENT.md: development and verification commands
- docs/DEPLOYMENT.md: deployment, smoke test, rollback, and recovery runbook
- docs/decisions/: accepted architecture decisions
- docs/changes/: immutable implementation history

Current foundation: Worker SSR, assets, environments, observability, health
checks, CI, and preview-first deployment automation. No data bindings yet.
